AKATI + SEKURITY
At AKATI Sekurity, we deliver proactive
cyber defense
built on two decades of real-world experience. We move beyond reactive measures like firewalls and antivirus software, focusing instead on anticipating and neutralizing threats before they strike. Our expertise is forged from protecting high-stakes clients—including banks, corporations, and government agencies—where there are no second chances. We provide advanced
threat intelligence
and tracking to understand and dismantle cybercriminal strategies, ensuring our clients’ systems remain secure against persistent, sophisticated attacks.
Strategic Cyber Defense for Business Resilience
Since 2007, AKATI Sekurity has become a global force in
cybersecurity
, securing over 400 organizations across five continents. Our mission is to provide the strategy, intelligence, and precision necessary for true
business resilience
. We ensure our clients are not just protected but fully prepared to operate in a landscape of increasing cyber threats. Our comprehensive security solutions empower businesses to move forward with confidence, free from the constant anxiety of an attack, by building a resilient foundation for growth and innovation.
Proactive Global Cybersecurity
Comprehensive Cybersecurity Services
Managed Security Services (MSSP): 24/7 Threat Monitoring and Response
Our Managed Security Services (MSSP) provide continuous, 24/7 protection by acting as a dedicated extension of your security team. We deliver real-time threat detection and response through advanced security analytics and AI-driven threat intelligence, ensuring potential threats are identified and neutralized before they can impact your business. This comprehensive, around-the-clock monitoring by our expert cybersecurity specialists offloads the burden of security operations, allowing you to focus on your core objectives with the confidence that your digital assets are fully protected.
Learn More
Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC): Achieve and Maintain Regulatory Compliance
Our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) services are designed to help your organization achieve regulatory excellence and build a strong foundation of operational security. We partner with you to implement robust security frameworks, align your operations with specific industry standards, and develop strategic programs to proactively mitigate risks. By integrating compliance into your security posture, we help you avoid penalties, build customer trust, and make informed, risk-aware business decisions.
Learn More
Security Consulting Services: Strategic Guidance to Strengthen Your Security Posture
Our Security Consulting Services provide the strategic, expert guidance needed to strengthen your cybersecurity posture and align it with your specific business goals. Our consultants conduct comprehensive risk assessments, design actionable and long-term security roadmaps, and help implement cutting-edge solutions tailored to your unique operational environment. This collaborative approach ensures your security investments are optimized, your defenses are resilient, and your organization is prepared for the evolving threat landscape.
Learn More
Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR): Rapid Response to Cyber Incidents
When a cyber incident occurs, our Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) services provide a rapid and decisive response to minimize damage and restore your operations swiftly. Our experts conduct in-depth forensic investigations to uncover the root cause of the breach, identify complex attack vectors, and determine the full scope of the compromise. From this analysis, we implement targeted remediation strategies to eradicate the threat, recover critical systems, and harden your defenses to prevent future attacks.
Learn More
